Display text of table cells

Source: R/table_format.R
pub_cell_text.Rd

Returns the text that pubflow shows for each cell of a table, which is the same in every output format (HTML, Word, PDF, Markdown). Use it to check the exact text of a table in tests.

Usage

pub_cell_text(ht)

Arguments

ht

A huxtable, e.g. from pub_table().

Value

A character matrix with one element per cell (also for cells hidden by merged cells).

Details

Numbers

Numeric cells are formatted by their number_format (see pub_table()):

number_formatResult
whole number n (at most 324)n decimal places
sprintf() format, e.g. "%.1f %%"text around one %.nf, %.ne or %.ng
functionmust return one string per value (NA: the cell's na_string)
NAas.character()

Numbers are rounded half away from zero, as by pub_round() (0.125 -> "0.13", 2.675 -> "2.68", -0.001 -> "0.00"). pub_format_num() gives the same text for numbers in steps. A function format rounds as it likes.

Numbers in text cells (as huxtable and pub_table() store them) are only formatted if their number_format is not NA; text cells have none.

Other cells

  • Missing values show the cell's na_string.

  • Factors show their labels, dates and times are shown in UTC.

  • Numbers inside text are never reformatted.

  • Markdown cells (huxtable::markdown()) are text, whatever their number_format.

  • Struck-through cells (see pub_strikeout()) show their Markdown, e.g. "~~2.71~~".

See also

pub_table()

Examples

ht <- pub_table(
    data.frame(x = c(0.125, 2.675, NA), n = c(1L, 2L, NA)),
    digits = c(x = 2), na = "-"
)
pub_cell_text(ht)
#>      [,1]   [,2]
#> [1,] "x"    "n" 
#> [2,] "0.13" "1" 
#> [3,] "2.68" "2" 
#> [4,] "-"    "-" 


# Different number formats - define small helper first
fmt_helper <- function(ht, format) {
    pub_cell_text(huxtable::set_number_format(ht, -1, "x", format))[, 1]
}
fmt_helper(ht, "%.1f %%")                                # like sprintf()
#> [1] "x"     "0.1 %" "2.7 %" "-"    
fmt_helper(ht, list(\(v) sprintf("<%s>", format(v))))    # custom function
#> [1] "x"       "<0.125>" "<2.675>" "-"      
fmt_helper(ht, NA)                                       # as.character() via NA
#> [1] "x"     "0.125" "2.675" "-"    


# Factors, times (UTC) and struck-through cells
df <- data.frame(
    group = factor(c("low", "high", NA)),
    time = as.POSIXct(c("2026-01-05 13:30:00", NA, NA), tz = "UTC"),
    x = c(2.71, 3.1, 4)
)
ht <- pub_table(df, digits = c(x = 2), na = "-")
pub_cell_text(pub_strikeout(ht, 2, "x"))
#>      [,1]    [,2]                      [,3]      
#> [1,] "group" "time"                    "x"       
#> [2,] "low"   "2026-01-05 13:30:00 UTC" "~~2.71~~"
#> [3,] "high"  "-"                       "3.10"    
#> [4,] "-"     "-"                       "4.00"
